label: ACCEPT
reason: Members label their Meta and fields with _() even for internal fields (common/models.py Attachment Meta verbose_name; scim/models.py ScimConfiguration 'Secret Digest'; machine/models.py MachineConfig; users/models.py ApiToken 'Key', TipResult 'Tip ID/Name').
